html:
If you searched "how much does house cleaning cost" for Piedmont, you have probably already seen a wide range of numbers and wondered why. The honest reason is that two houses with the same square footage can need very different amounts of work. This article explains what actually sets the price for house cleaning in Piedmont, so you can compare quotes fairly, and what we do differently when we give ours.

How much does house cleaning cost in Piedmont?

We do not give a dollar figure in an article or over the phone, and there is a reason. A price that is not based on your house is a guess, and a guess is how people end up disappointed at the bill or at the clean. At Perfect Services the price comes after a free in-home estimate. We visit, look at the rooms, ask about your priorities and give you one number in writing. You can book the visit with the form on the Piedmont booking page, by calling (864) 399-5168 or by texting (864) 666-8520.

The five things that set the price

Home size and layout

More rooms and more square feet take more time. Layout matters as much as size: an open plan with one large floor is quicker than a house with many small rooms, stairs and lots of trim.

Bedrooms and bathrooms

Bathrooms are the most time-intensive rooms. A three-bedroom house with one bathroom is not the same job as a three-bedroom with three, because each bathroom needs scrubbing, disinfecting and detail work.

Frequency

Weekly and biweekly visits cost less per visit than monthly ones. A house that is cleaned often stays close to standard, so each visit goes faster than one after a month of build-up.

Pets and kids

Hair, dander and heavy traffic add some time, especially along baseboards, upholstery and the entry. Tell us what lives in the house and we will plan for it.

The first visit

The first clean is usually deeper, to bring the home up to the maintenance standard. After that, regular visits are lighter and often faster.

What a regular visit includes

  • Kitchen counters, sink and stovetop cleaned and sanitized
  • Appliance fronts and handles wiped
  • Bathrooms: toilet, shower, tub, mirrors and chrome
  • Floors vacuumed and mopped by hand
  • Surfaces, shelves and furniture dusted
  • Beds made and trash emptied
  • Baseboards and door frames touched up on a rotation
  • Light switches and high-touch spots wiped

How to compare quotes without getting burned

Ask three questions of any company. First, is the price based on a visit or on a guess? Second, what is included, listed in writing? Third, what happens if you are not satisfied? A quote that does not answer these is not much use. In Piedmont, a historic mill town on the Saluda River with newer neighborhoods nearby, homes range from older houses with original trim to recent builds, and the same flat rate cannot fit both.

How long does a clean take, and when can we start?

For a typical home, a visit takes a few hours with a small crew, longer on the first one. Piedmont is about 21 miles from Greer, roughly 35 minutes by road along I-85 and SC-20, so we plan the route in advance. If you want service soon, tell us when you call and we will say what is realistic for booking this week.

More background is on the house cleaning and maid service page. To see the same logic applied to a neighboring community, read how pricing works in Gantt or look at house cleaning in Pelzer. Our team's in-depth room notes are in bathrooms done right. For a quick request, use the free estimate form.

What to have ready for the estimate

The estimate goes faster, and the number is more accurate, if you think about a few things. Which rooms matter most to you, which can be skipped, and do you want recurring service or a single visit? Mention any surface that needs special care, such as unsealed wood or natural stone, so we plan the right method.

  • How many bedrooms and bathrooms
  • Pets and any room where they spend time
  • Preferred frequency: weekly, biweekly, monthly or one time
  • Anything you want added, such as inside the oven or fridge
  • Access: lockbox, garage code or someone at home

None of this requires cleaning ahead. We want to see the house the way it normally is, so the number is honest. After the visit, you get the price and a written list of what is included, and you can take your time deciding. If you go ahead, we can often find a first appointment within the week, depending on the calendar.

The first number is not a trap. Prices in the industry sometimes climb after the first visit because the quote was too low. We would rather quote right once and keep the clients we have, which is why we look before we price.

Piedmont also has some very different homes within a few miles of each other, from older mill-era houses to newer neighborhoods. That is exactly why a visit comes before a number.
